metadata.description: Itixo marketplace with plugins for Copilot CLI. Recommended: also add the caveman marketplace (https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) and Mattpocock Skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).

plugins.name: itixo
plugins.description: Itixo library for Copilot CLI users: agents, skills, rules, prompts. Orchestration module included (delegation to cheaper-model subagents). Recommended companions: the caveman marketplace (https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) and Mattpocock Skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).

plugins.name: itixo-component-library
plugins.description: Consumer guide for the @itixo/component-library design system: install, Tailwind v4 wiring, DashboardLayout, design tokens, and the component/prop reference.

plugins.name: turborepo
plugins.description: A pack of microfrontends managing skills for Turborepo monorepos.
